description: continuous from S08 (identical frame): the long reverb tail of the last echo pulse carries over; S08’s gold motes drift off the lens
the POWERS-OF-TEN PULL-BACK begins: a sub-bass rise + airy whoosh whose pitch follows the zoom speed (peaks f80–110, eases on the Earth f52–68 and the Milky Way f124–150)
S08’s last pulse (fired at its f568): echo tap +7 f still ringing in the head (amp 0.5)
echo tap +14 f (amp 0.26) — the last trace of the brain’s rhythm as the figure shrinks away
night street: sodium-lamp hum, distant traffic (car lights streaming on the arterials), fading by Z≈5
odometer rolls to 10^1 m — level name types in: 街区 (street)
C2 「宇宙，一路滚向平衡。」 condenses
odometer rolls to 10^3 m — level name types in: 城市 (city)
odometer rolls to 10^5 m — level name types in: 地球 (Earth)
the Earth’s night side: city clusters strung by highways — a faint radio-static shimmer, airglow
odometer rolls to 10^8 m — level name types in: 地月系 (Earth–Moon)
the pale blue dot sits in a ray of scattered sunlight (Voyager): a single high glassy tone
odometer rolls to 10^10 m — level name types in: 太阳系 (solar system)
planet orbits sweep past (tiny pings, one per orbit)
odometer rolls to 10^13 m — level name types in: 奥尔特云 (Oort cloud)
stars stream outward in the log-space tunnel: granular sparkle, densest f100–118
odometer rolls to 10^16 m — level name types in: 恒星 (stars)
C3 「途中，它在一些角落，/ 暂时织出了结构：」 (cut off by the hard cut at f210)
odometer rolls to 10^20 m — level name types in: 银河系 (Milky Way)
the Milky Way resolves around you (you are on an arm): wide warm pad
odometer rolls to 10^21 m — level name types in: 本星系群 (Local Group)
Local Group & galaxy field: the pad thins to a cold shimmer
the cosmic web fades in (violet light along filaments): low choir-like drone rising to the cut
odometer rolls to 10^23 m — level name types in: 宇宙网 (cosmic web)
HARD CUT + 2-frame flash: a galaxy (on the circle) — 「星系。」 (punch hit, everything else cut)
HARD CUT + flash: a living cell, same circle — 「细胞。」
HARD CUT + flash: an eye, same circle — 「你。」 (strongest hit)
silence after the third hit (only a near-inaudible room tone)
the eye looks up (抬起头): a soft inhale; the web glints in the cornea (faint high shimmer)
C7 「然后，其中最小的一块，/ 抬起头问：时间是什么？」 (时间是什么？ in gold)
the push into the pupil begins: a slow deep whoosh accelerating to f416
the pupil’s dark opens onto the web: the web drone returns inside the whoosh
the web fills the frame (the eye is gone)
INVERSION: emissive → transmission — the drone turns inside out (reverse swell, spectrum flips, highs → lows) as the web becomes ink from the water line down
S01’s tank returns: room tone, the hum of the light table, soft bubbles
the silver hairline of the surface draws itself from the centre outward: a thin glass tone spreading in stereo
the inverted web hands over to the ink: it is now ink in water
the ink starts to sink and curl: slow liquid textures, eddies spinning up one by one (to f~640), a low drone that keeps rising with the S-gauge
S-gauge fades in at the left (ink-coloured); it only rises from here
C9 「墨，终将散开。」
the tank’s water begins to run down through an invisible form: the web’s threads sag and bend onto an outline (crown first) — a low, slowly rising current tone
ink pours down the outline from the crown, both sides together (to f604): a wet bristle hiss descending in stereo, drips at the hands and feet
C10 「但在散开的路上——」 = S05’s 「但在滚落的路上——」 (same layout, same musical motif as S05 C8)
the figure is complete — held while the ink keeps streaming down its outline (warm sustained chord)
C11 「它画出了你。」
你 is written stroke by stroke with a real brush (the only brush glyph in the film): 7 strokes in stroke order to f682 — a soft press-and-flick per stroke
the form is let go: the current through it eases off, its ink joins the water and diffuses (the chord dissolves, to f~760)
。 lands as the brush lifts (f~683–699), closing the sentence
◀◀ ×8 timecode flickers in under the water line (mono clicks)
REWIND ATTEMPT: tape strain / reverse squeal, digits run back ×8 with a chromatic split — the picture does not follow, the ink keeps spreading
title 「熵 · 时间 · 生命」 condenses out of the melting ◀◀ ink (shāng over 熵): final theme statement, held 1.5 s
the ◀◀ itself bleeds into ink and sinks: the reverse sound collapses into a soft liquid gurgle
a last drop falls into view from above the frame (tiny whistle, 0.85 s)
the drop breaks the surface (plink + low thump, ripples, a small vortex ring); the title starts dissolving into ink
the light table switches off: the hum dies (power-down), the tank goes dark
the hairline of light contracts toward the centre: a thin high tone narrowing
the hairline is a single point of light
the point goes out: pure black #000, total silence to the end (loops to S01’s cold open)
